answer: A farm cannot self-supply those since the attesters must be independent on the vertex graph. Re-attestations are stored in garden and falcon lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 2 peers re-attest it every 20 epochs, so holding a position demands ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 613 impostors cost 834 times the honest price and take 13 times as long to clear. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
